build_eplb_state: build an EplbState instance to manage expert parallelism load balancing for MoE models
add_model_to_eplb: add a MixtureOfExperts model to EplbState with model config and device for expert load tracking
rearrange_experts: rearrange expert weights across GPUs based on current load using the selected EPLB policy
compute_logical_maps: compute logical_to_physical_map and logical_replica_count from a physical_to_logical_map tensor
step_eplb_state: step the EPLB state to record expert load metrics and trigger rebalancing when threshold is reached
